description: This file defines REST API endpoints for a notes application using FastAPI. It provides functions for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting notes, interacting with a memory-based storage layer.

methods.name: List[Note] list_notes()
methods.description: Returns a list of all notes by fetching from storage and converting each record to a Note schema.

methods.name: Note create_note(payload: NoteCreate)
methods.description: Creates a new note with provided title and content, returning the created Note schema.

methods.name: Note get_note( note_id: int = Path(..., ge=1, description="ID of the note to retrieve"), )
methods.description: Retrieves a note by ID; raises a 404 error if not found.

methods.name: Note update_note( payload: NoteUpdate, note_id: int = Path(..., ge=1, description="ID of the note to update"), )
methods.description: Updates a note's title and/or content by ID; raises errors if no fields are provided or note is not found.

methods.name: None delete_note( note_id: int = Path(..., ge=1, description="ID of the note to delete"), )
methods.description: Deletes a note by ID; raises a 404 error if not found.

ctags.name: delete_note
ctags.signature: ( note_id: int = Path(..., ge=1, description="ID of the note to delete"), )

ctags.name: get_note
ctags.signature: ( note_id: int = Path(..., ge=1, description="ID of the note to retrieve"), )
